account_number_handling: The account number does not appear in this artifact. Only its shape does, which is what the provenance guard reads and what a reader needs to check it.

defects.status_reported_by_operator: The stage prompt records MBT_IB_PAPER_CLIENT_ID as now set, and it is set. It is set to a value that is not a client id, so the named blocker is not in fact cleared.
defects.what: MBT_IB_PAPER_CLIENT_ID holds the PAPER ACCOUNT NUMBER, not a client id.
defects.where: .env (gitignored operator configuration, not a registered rule)
defects.why_it_cannot_be_intended: The TWS API clientId is an int32. A 9-character D-prefixed string cannot be one, so this is a paste of the account number rather than a choice.

defects.family: Same family as the Guard 1 hole the Stage B mutation harness found: a check that refuses correctly on the inputs it is pointed at, while the path that actually matters goes unchecked.
defects.second_and_worse_half: ValueError from int() embeds the offending value in its message. With D-1 present that value IS the account number, so the account number reaches stderr and would reach any artifact that captured the traceback. tests/test_honesty.py scans TRACKED FILES for account shapes and cannot see a runtime exception path, so the scan was clean while the hole was open.
defects.what: The client id is passed to a bare int() with no validation. A malformed value raises ValueError, which is NOT a ConfigError, so cli._connect_or_record_absent does not catch it and the CLI exits on an uncaught traceback instead of recording a typed absence.

found_before: any session was opened and any figure was measured
what_is_not_amended: Neither defect is a registered rule. REGISTRATION.md is closed and untouched. The premium basis, the ATM strike rule, the tenor rule, the distinctness rule and the refusal conditions are obeyed as written.
